item.title: Orb 0.1.0-beta.11
item.description: Draw shapes while recording: the pen button on the recording bar now opens a palette with rectangle, ellipse and arrow tools. Hold Shift for a square, a circle, or a straight arrow.

item.title: Orb 0.1.0-beta.10
item.description:
• Interactive recordings sound right. Your voice and Orb's are now mixed at the same level. Before, your voice could come out much quieter than the assistant's.
  • "Prompt copied" when a recording finishes. Orb copies the agent prompt for you and shows a small pill, so you can paste straight into your agent. You can turn this off in Settings.
  • Setup ends with your first recording. The last setup page walks you through making one with the shortcut.
  • Optional Accessibility access. If you allow it, in setup or in Settings, Orb notices window and tab switches as they happen. It never clicks or types for you.

item.title: Orb 0.1.0-beta.9
item.description:
• Send Feedback. It's in the Orb menu, the menu bar and the sidebar. Write a note and it comes straight to me. Add your email if you'd like a reply. You can also record what went wrong as a normal take; it stays on your Mac.
  • A friendlier first run. Setup now lets you practise the record shortcut, or change it, and shows how a recording gets handed to your AI assistant.
  • Fewer dead ends. If a recording can't start, Orb's window comes forward and says why. If you decline the microphone, Orb records the screen alone instead of failing. And when there's no summary, it says why in plain words.
  • Interactive mode is no longer marked Experimental. After ten minutes of silence it pauses, so it stops using your OpenAI credit. Resuming picks the conversation back up.
  • Privacy. The anonymous daily ping now also says yes or no to whether this copy has ever recorded, copied a handoff, or shared a link. It still sends nothing from your recordings. A new copy sends nothing until you finish setup, and you can turn the ping off in Settings › Privacy.

item.title: Orb 0.1.0-beta.8
item.description:
• The slim scrollbar now moves as you scroll, instead of staying at the top.
  • New users are walked through granting screen and microphone access on first run.
  • Orb's icon can be dragged straight into the Screen Recording list in System Settings.

item.title: Orb 0.1.0-beta.7
item.description: A maintenance build. Nothing in the app changes for you; this update only picks up improvements to how Orb is built and released.

item.title: Orb 0.1.0-beta.6
item.description: • Updates are easier to find. Orb ▸ Check for Updates… sits under About Orb, and when a new version has downloaded, a small card above Settings offers to restart into it. The right-click menu bar menu offers the same. Orb still installs updates on its own the next time it quits, and never restarts during a recording.

item.title: Orb 0.1.0-beta.5
item.description: Slimmer scrollbars: the sessions sidebar, session pages and Settings now use a thin, unobtrusive scrollbar with no track, which darkens when you hover over it.

item.title: Orb 0.1.0-beta.4
item.description: Anonymous install counting. Once a day, Orb now sends a random ID for this copy, its version, and your macOS version, so we can see how many people use it. It never sends recordings, transcripts, or anything on your screen. You can turn it off in Settings → Privacy, which also deletes the ID.

item.title: Orb 0.1.0-beta.3
item.description:
First beta of Orb: show your agent what you mean.

  • Record and talk. Press the shortcut, walk through your screen, and say what you're thinking. Orb transcribes on your Mac and gives the recording a title.
  • Hand it to your agent. Click Copy agent prompt and paste it into Claude Code, Codex or any agent with a terminal. It gets your narration, screenshots and which apps you were in.
  • Interactive mode (experimental). A GPT-Live voice thought partner that talks back while you record and can point at things on your screen. It needs your own OpenAI API key, and while it's on, your audio goes to OpenAI.

Before you start: Orb needs macOS 26 on an Apple Silicon Mac. Summaries and titles use Apple Intelligence. The first time you press Record, macOS asks for Screen Recording permission: turn Orb on in System Settings, then quit and reopen Orb. Cloud share links are coming soon. Orb updates itself when new betas come out.
